data.professional_title: STRATEGIC BUSINESS &TECHNOLOGY MANAGER|PROGRAMME MANAGEMENT |SERVICE DELIVERY |ITSERVICES GROWTH
data.summary: Transformational IT and Business Leader with ~18 years of expertise in driving large-scale IT transformations, enterprise automation, and cybersecurity initiatives for Fortune 100/500 , G2000 companies. Proven track record in crafting strategic technology roadmaps that seamlessly integrate digital capabilities with business objectives, maximizing efficiency, scalability, and profitability. Strategic IT Portfolio & Program Architect:Spearheading complex global technology programs, optimizing cost structures, and enhancing IT service delivery to drive business impact & scalability. P&L-Focused Technology Leader:Driving CAGR-driven growth, managing multimillion-dollar IT initiatives with strategic POVs. Ensuring financial governance, optimizing costs, and maximizing ROI through tech innovation and efficiency enhancements. Consultative Sales & Deal-Making Strategist: Leading high-stakes negotiations, presales, RFPs, RFIs, RFQ’s, Client Workshops and Complex Engagement Assestementssecuring multimillion-dollar contracts through strategic deal-making and client engagements. Enterprise IT Operations & Cybersecurity Expert:Leading cloud governance, security compliance, and infrastructure modernization to strengthen IT resilience and mitigate risks. Digital Transformation & Automation Champion: Accelerating IT innovation by implementing workload automation, AI-driven efficiencies, and enterprise-wide digital modernization strategies. Trusted Executive Partner & Risk Management Strategist: Collaborating with C-suite and senior leadership to align IT strategies with business goals, and implement robust risk mitigation frameworks, ensuring operational resilience and long-term sustainability. People-Centric Leader & Mentor: Building and mentoring high-performing global teams, driving efficiency enhancements, and fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

experience.company: SHI (FORMERLY LOCUZ ENTERPRISE SOLUTIONS)– M&A TO BE COMPLETED BY 2027
responsibilities: Managed diverse SHI “Managed ServiceProvided”10+offerings~150M$(1% of SHI Revnue)for 30K–50K global customers across O365, Azure, AWS, GCP, End-User Computing, Virtualization, Citrix, HPE, Veeam, Druva, Keeper, SentinelOne, and networking solutions including Cisco Meraki and Fortinet.
Directed delivery of a la carte service portfoliosaligned with SHI’s MSP Tier-3 support model, ensuring seamless integration of managed, consultative, and professional services.

Led an offshore team of 30+ L3 experts and an onshore team of 100 professionals across L1–L3, serving as the first point of contact for all technological issues. Oversaw resolution of complex break-fix incidents (60%), managed services (20%), and consultative/advisory engagements (20%). When issues required escalation, coordinated directly with vendors and OEMs to ensure timely resolution and minimal business disruption.

Owned the full customer lifecycle, from acquisition and onboarding through implementation and steady state operations, consistently improving service quality and client satisfaction. Established governance frameworks with daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly cadences, embedding service reviews and continuous improvement initiatives into operations.

experience.company: DEXIAN – A STAFFING COMPANY (BANGKOK/CHENNAI) – FOR EXXONMOBIL
responsibilities: Participated in ExxonMobil’s $50M workload automation migration program, supporting a 40 members Chennai team and 10K+ users across 4 SoWs, contributing to $2.5M revenue—followed by inception of WLA Tools CoE. {Hired for Bangkok client location Program Manager requirement}. They lost requirement or position in month of July’25.

Driving large-scale IT transformation, cybersecurity, cloud migration, and enterprise automation initiatives post-Kyndryl spinoff, ensuring seamless transitions and cost optimizations. Leading security compliance, TSA exitactivities, middleware health checks, and enterprise-wide automation programs while aligning cloud governance (Azure, GCP, OCI) with regulatory mandates. Collaborating with security architects, cloud engineers, compliance teams, and business stakeholders to implement scalable solutions. Governing the entire program lifecycle from inception to retirement, ensuring alignment with business goals, cost-effectiveness, risk mitigation, and seamless, on-time delivery within budget.

Led complex Security Platform Services (SPS) Program, overseeing 9 key managed and consult security services (IAM, Patching, Vulnerability Management, Risk & Compliance, etc.) within ManagedApps Engagement.

Spearheaded the ManagedApps Engagement, delivering SAP and Oracle service offerings to 400+ small customers while overseeing a vast infrastructure estate of 40,000 systems across SoftLayer, Azure, AWS, GCP, SAP, and OCI platforms (as of 2020).

Directed the management of 500 S&R infrastructure tools and 40,000 security endpoint agents, ensuring robust security, seamless operations, and optimized performance across a diverse technology & tools landscape. Tools are not just limited to Tennable, Nessus, TrendMicro, CrowdStrike, MS Sentinel, Redhat Sattelite, Redhat Yum , ELK, Splunk, Okta, UAT, Delina, Zoho Corp Manage Engine – PMP, CISCO Keena.VM, ApexaiQ, ServiceNow GRC, And - Working in-line to best practice enablelment Vulnerability Audit file by implementing statnadards from Authorities like CIS, DISA, Microsoft SCT, Kyndryl CyberSecurity Data Privacy Standards & Technical Speicfications, Global Health Check Proces..etc
Steered the execution of 20 projects, 3 programs, and 50+ SPS Service improvement initiatives, including CIO-led mandates, strengthening security resilience and operational efficiency.
Leveraged a P&L-focused approach to optimize resource allocation, applying strategic POVs to cut costs from $4M to $0.9M while ensuring long-term financial sustainability and operational excellence.

Played Pivotal role as Technical Project Manager for CISO Lead OKTA Implementation Post Spin-off from IBM to Kyndryl. Transitioned the project to the CIO team when the scope expanded from a CISO-wide OKTA implementation to a Kyndryl-wide OKTA solution implementation.
Maintained 85% compliance with S&R KPIs, metrics and MSAC audit requirements over seven quarters, ensuring service stability and security adherence.

Delivered 3 modernization projects (anti-malware & vulnerability management) focused on service optimization and operational excellence, alongside 2 vulnerability management service migration projects, improving security posture and performance.

Orchestrated ProxyCap migration for 22,500 Windows and 2,500 Linux users after the IBM-Kyndryl spinoff, streamlining software license procurement, cutting SKUs from 35,000 to 22,500, and driving significant cost savings.
Led security audits, middleware compliance, and infrastructure health checks across Azure, GCP, OCI, IBM Cloud, and SoftLayer, ensuring robust vulnerability management for 20+ subsystems.

Actively participated in designing the Global Security Health process, integrating Technical Specification into ManagedApps ADAI to enhance security. Executed ~4M security health checks across 7,000 assets and 20 subsystems, averaging 30 checks per device, ensuring compliance and health check vulnerabilities remediation.

Designed & deployed Kyndryl’s first large-scale employee community (~30,000 users – ProxyCap Communications), integrating structured ServiceNow notifications, eliminating ad-hoc email blasts, and streamlining enterprise communications.
Contributed to the CIO-led TSA exit program, assessing 12 critical SPS tools using the 7R framework (rehost, retire, refactor, retain etc.).

Applied a CAGR-driven strategy to optimize SPS tool infrastrcture footprint by 85% (500 to 75), driving 200% cost savings while driving operational stability. Strengthened security operations by deploying CrowdStrike, TrendMicro, Nessus, Tenable, and AI-driven threat detection tools, improving threat intelligence and vulnerability management under IBM Fellow & CISO leadership.

Actively participated in 15+ industry communities across project management, service management, solution architecture, and security governance. Advocated diversity & inclusion through active participation in PWD (Persons with Disabilities) programs and workplace accessibility initiatives.

experience.role: Technical Services Specialist & Project Manager {IBM GTS Full Time Employee Roles}
responsibilities: Oversaw large-scale IT operations, security transformations, and automation initiatives for financial and enterprise customers, ensuring seamless execution, while building and managing high-performing delivery teams. Led multi-million-dollar AI-Ops deployments, security infrastructure migrations, and cloud security compliance programs, driving operational efficiency, cybersecurity resilience, and cost optimization. Steered tactical organisation planning with leadership on resource mobilisation, cost saving, financial management, and efficiency.

Led the $3.2M JAWS AI-Ops deployment for State Street, creating a unified view for cross-business batch flows. Optimized Tier-0 to Tier-2 critical path analysis, boosting batch efficiency by 150% and cutting cost by 25%, eliminating bottlenecks in mission-critical processes.

Successfully led the Vyatta to Cisco vSRX firewall migration, overcoming previous implementation challenges to enhance network security resilience, prevent $1M in potential losses, and achieve $50K in cost savings through infrastructure optimization.

Steered the migration of 35,000 IBM/Kyndryl employees from OpenText SOCKS to ProxyCap, reducing licenses to 25K SKUs within 9 months. Partnered with DWS, Software Lifecycle, and Enterprise Patch teams, adopting agile workflows & Kanban boards to resolve deployment challenges. Established an employee-led Yammer community for sustained support, transitioning L1/L2 issue triage to the helpdesk, enhancing self-service and engagement.

Progressed from WAAE Specialist to Technical Operations Manager & Tools CoE Architect, leading critical automation initiatives for CA WLA Tools, Managed Services, Consulting & Advisory Services. Spearheaded the architecture, deployment, and support of AutoSys environments for top-tier clients, ensuring 98% compliance, 24/7 incident resolution, and zero escalations. Optimized L1/L2 operations, enforcing Cognizant’s Operations Maturity & Delivery Excellence frameworks with Lean Six Sigma-based improvements. Led pre-sales efforts (RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, WLA assessments, pricing) and advised 30+ accounts on escalations, process improvements, and strategic growth. Built and led a 100+ member skill enablement community across L1-L4, while training 10,000+ Cognizant users on CA WLA Tools & add-ons, driving enterprise-wide upskilling and adoption.

Managed 30+ Workload Automation (WLA) engagements across 22 SMEs, driving $2.17M in revenue and implementing 10% YoY cost reductions. Oversaw a 100+ member technical team to optimize ~4+ billion daily batch job executions, driving end-to-end consulting, pre-sales, innovation, and automation excellence.

Recognized as an Innovation Champion for leading 20+ process optimization initiatives (CSIs, Lean Six Sigma, Kaizen), significantly enhancing workload automation efficiency and driving $30K+ in annual cost savings.
Established CoE Labs for CA WLA tools and multiple other Workload Automation (WLA) solutions, enhancing client value propositions through solution validation and representation.
Achieved a 90% reduction in database synchronization time during Disaster Recovery (DR) events, cutting it down from 90 minutes to just 10 minutes. Strategic Client Engagements & High-Value Deals:

Spearheaded 20+ RFPs across Greenfield and Brownfield engagements, driving revenue growth from $0.7M to $1.4M and achieving a 200% increase in the RFP success rate for Workload Automation (WLA) tools.
Marathon Petroleum: Led a 10-member team, optimizing mission-critical applications and driving $250K+ in cost savings through automation and Active Directory optimizations.

Loblaw (Canada) - Largest Engagement (~500 FTEs): Managed a direct team of 10, an administrator team of 8, and an indirect team of ~400 community members across 20 IT Towers. Transitioned L4/L5 services in 15 days, reducing major incidents from 2/week to zero in 18 months and improving metrics by 200%. Elevated Best-in-Class (BIC) performance score from 2.1 to 3.1 across 160+ key operational metrics. Stanley Black & Decker ($5M): Secured a $5M annual contract value (ACV) deal by collaborating with internal teams, pre-sales, and account management to develop a winning strategy, including proposal structuring and cover letter creation.
Nike - Engineering Operations & Large Deal Support ($100M): Played a key role in the $100M SAP infrastructure deal, collaborating with the SAP application team to position Cognizant competitively.

experience.company: CIBER SITES INDIA PVT. LTD., BENGALURU, INDIA (NOW HTC SOFTWARE)
responsibilities: Managed IT infrastructure, workload automation, and solution design for enterprise clients, ensuring seamless global IT operations. Led the deployment, administration, and optimization of automation tools, aligning technology solutions with business objectives. Spearheaded tool migrations, upgrades, and integrations while directing technical consulting, process automation, and vendor collaborations to enhance operational efficiency and system stability. Drove end-to-end solutions from presales to implementation, ensuring high-quality service delivery and seamless system transitions.

Provided L2.5 support for a diverse range of infrastructure tools, including Autosys, IT Patch Manager, Nagios, Netcool, CA Spectrum, and other CA/non-CA tools, ensuring seamless operations across US, UK, and India teams.

Led the administration, deployment, and maintenance of CA Workload Automation AE (AutoSys) across 3 environments, ensuring seamless operations. Managed complex multi-tenant production environments, optimizing workload automation and infrastructure monitoring for high-profile clients. Earned recognition for leading the successful migration of a retail client's QA environment from AutoSys R4.5.1 to R11.3 SP1. Collaborated with global teams across the US, UK, and India, ensuring efficient service delivery and infrastructure management.

experience.company: AFFILIATED COMPUTER SERVICES INDIA PVT. LTD., BENGALURU, INDIA
responsibilities: Established and led an 8-FTE L3 Engineering Operations team, overseeing the design, implementation, and management of AutoSys environments for 15+ global clients, ensuring system stability, performance optimization, and compliance.

Designed, implemented, and managed diverse infrastructure environments within a large datacenter hosting multiple FT500 clients, ensuring seamless operations and high availability. Led the management of 15+ global clients, including Nike Inc., Allergan, Symetra, and MeadWestvaco, by overseeing critical infrastructure tools and ensuring 24/7 system stability, rapid incident resolution, and optimized performance.

Served as the primary focal point from India for Nike Inc., collaborating closely with the onshore team to drive operational excellence. Led critical migrations for Nike, including AutoSys 4.5.1 to R11 SP2 and Oracle 10g to 11g RAC, ensuring seamless transitions through rigorous SIT, UAT, and production cut-over while enhancing system performance and data integrity.

Engineered automation solutions, including the ODR process and Automated JIL Creation, saving 500+ man-hours annually while optimizing WCC applications and database indexes to enhance system performance and reduce latency.

Earned multiple client accolades for swiftly resolving P1/P2 incidents, ensuring seamless business operations for Nike and other global enterprises, while leading audits and change management to uphold compliance and security standards.

responsibilities: Campus Hire Worked as L1, L2, L3 Roles for 2 WLA Tools and 5 Clients as part of 20 members global team.
